title: Mijn huis
goal: Describe a home, its rooms, and what is present in them.

content.text:
Grammer:
er is / er zijn,
indefinite vs definite noun references,
basic review of de/het

Topic Vocabulary:
rooms
furniture
parts of a home

Er is en er zijn
purpose: Introduce existence before teaching precise location.
Use 'er is' for one thing and 'er zijn' for more than one thing when saying that something exists or is present. Questions use 'is er' and 'zijn er'.

props.note: The balcony is being introduced for the first time.
The same inversion happens with plural 'zijn er'. This also previews the neighborhood lesson.

content.text: Zijn er winkels in de buurt?
